title: School Reopening - Term 1, 2024
message: Welcome back! School reopens on Monday, January 8th, 2024. All students should report by 7:30 AM for assembly.

title: Grade 12 Mock Examinations
message: Grade 12 mock examinations will commence on February 5th, 2024. Students should collect their examination timetables from the office.

title: Inter-House Sports Competition
message: The annual inter-house sports competition will be held on March 15th, 2024. All students are encouraged to participate in various sporting activities.

title: School Fees Payment Reminder
message: This is a reminder that Term 1 school fees are due by January 31st, 2024. Please make payments at the accounts office or through mobile money.

title: Science Fair 2024
message: Students interested in participating in the annual science fair should submit their project proposals by February 20th, 2024.

title: Parent-Teacher Conference
message: The quarterly parent-teacher conference is scheduled for February 10th, 2024, from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Please book your appointment slots.
